author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.8 - Important fix: reverts the TCP keepalive change from 0.19.7. On Hubitat 2.5.1 the new socket keepalive options can't be used from a driver (the platform blocks them with a security error), which caused the thermostat connection to fail and the device to appear stuck 'connecting' after a reconnect. This release restores the previous, reliable connection behavior. If you installed 0.19.7, please update. (Keepalive will return once Hubitat makes that option usable from drivers.)
